subject: general
question: What is the name of the grant-in-aid scheme of the department under the Tribal Sub Plan that aims at improving living conditions and empowerment of scheduled tribes based on sustainable science and technology (S & T) activities/application?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Technological Interventions for Tribal Empowerment (TITE)__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tribal Sub Plan Technological Interventions for Tribal Empowerment (TITE):** 
 
• The **department's grant-in-aid scheme for the Tribal Sub Plan**, TITE aims to **improve the living conditions of scheduled tribes** and give them more power through **sustainable science and technology (S&T) activities and applications.**
 
• **By creating an action research project, S&T applications and interventions should meet the following goals:**
 
 
• To **encourage** research, development, and adaptation of science and technology to improve the lives of tribal groups.
 
• **Start of S&T-based programmes** in major socioeconomic sectors that are tailored to the location.
 
• To** keep traditional artisan skills** alive by building on local innovation and knowledge systems and using a participatory research approach to make local resource management plans.
 
• To** look into and promote alternative ways **to make a living in places where people are losing their jobs, focusing on innovative community-based approaches and technological options to increase the impact on the ground.
 
• To** improve the equipment and machinery** that is already there and to bring in new techniques, systems, and a full set of technology.
 
• **Widening the effect of the above S&T-based activities** by encouraging the replication and scaling up of successful approaches that lead to empowering tribal populations and building their technical skills.
